purpose: Form CSR-1 is used by entities intending to undertake CSR activities to register themselves with the Central Government electronically.
who: Every entity covered under sub-rule (1) who intends to undertake any CSR activity
when: With effect from the 01st day of April 2021
steps: Ensure the entity is of a type covered under sub-rule (1) intended for CSR implementation.
Sign and submit Form CSR-1 electronically.
Have the form verified digitally by a Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Cost Accountant in practice.
File the form with the Registrar on the portal.
checklist: Check that the entity is established under section 8 of the Act, is a registered public trust, registered society, or an entity established under an Act of Parliament or State legislature.
Verify income tax exemptions or registrations under section 10(23C) or section 12A and 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961 if applicable.
Confirm the entity has an established track record of at least three years in undertaking similar activities, if required by sub-rule (1)(d).
Arrange for digital verification by a practicing Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Cost Accountant.
watch: Provisions of this sub-rule shall not affect CSR projects or programmes approved prior to the 01st day of April 2021.
